metadata.name: pocket-bridge

paragraphs.text: A lightweight, encrypted phone interface for DeepSeek Harness on your Windows PC, with an optional D
SH Settings plugin for pairing, gateway controls, and diagnostics.
# Pocket Bridge
A lightweight, unofficial phone interface for **DeepSeek Harness (DSH) running on your own Windows c
omputer**. Open a browser on your phone to work with local projects and conversations, send instruct
ions, respond to supported approvals, and transfer workspace files. Your computer runs DSH; Pocket B
ridge provides the connection and a small browser interface.
**New releases focus exclusively on DSH.** Codex and Dot are retired from the new gateway and Window
s installer. Previous combined releases and their installers remain available in GitHub Releases, wi
th no further integration updates. Upgrading preserves the installation directory, connection keys,
device records, uploads, and existing local journals. It does not close Codex, delete its conversati
ons, or remove your target applications.
Pocket Bridge is independent and unofficial. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by DeepSeek, Open
AI, or Cloudflare. DSH, model access, and any provider fees are separate. See third-party notices.
Other community phone clients and plugins exist, including DSH Mobile Remote, dsh-mobile, and dsh-Re
mote. Pocket Bridge focuses on a small browser interface, a Windows installer, bounded thumbnail-fir
st image viewing, protected content transport and exact-version compatibility reporting. Its optiona
l plugin reuses an identified gateway and exposes actionable local diagnostics. Consult each project
's own platform, protocol and security requirements before choosing it.
## What it does

- Browse projects on the computer, add an existing directory, and create conversations.
- Send messa

ges and view streamed replies, exposed reasoning, tool activity, and queued messages.
- Check comput
er-side submission receipts after a reload or a prepared entrance change. Uncertain instructions are
never resent automatically; identical intentional questions remain possible after explicit review.
- Select models and tool presets reported by the connected runtime. Check supported permission prese

ts through a readback instead of assuming a command succeeded.
- Handle approvals, choices, and ques

tions when the runtime exposes that capability.
- Upload attachments and browse, preview, or downloa
d permitted workspace files. Authorized image references near the transcript viewport load a small t
humbnail first; opening or downloading the original is an explicit action. Supported attachment IDs
use the runtime's session-authorized reader. Local file links remain subject to workspace or exact l
ocal approval checks; unavailable sources display an error rather than silently reading another file

.
- View supported goals, plan controls, balance information, and an explicitly requested desktop sc

reenshot.
- Use an encrypted local connection or an optional temporary Cloudflare tunnel. No phone a
an encrypted local connection or an optional temporary Cloudflare tunnel. No phone app is required.
Capabilities depend on the installed DSH runtime, its plugins, and the connected account. This is a
purpose-built mobile interface, not a complete reproduction of every desktop plugin. Unsupported ope
rations must be explained or unavailable rather than presented as working buttons. Read the compatib
ility matrix and manual acceptance record.
## Images and local file links
Preview.21 recognizes supported local Markdown image and file links and builds image controls or fil
e actions with DOM elements. A link is metadata, not permission to read a computer file; it is never
turned into an unrestricted browser `href` or used to grant access. The new preview path does not a
utomatically fetch remote image URLs.
Images close to the visible transcript request JPEG thumbnails no larger than 960 pixels on either s
ide and 200 KiB. The Windows converter can choose a smaller size to meet that byte limit. The page r
uns at most two image reads concurrently, and each gateway runs one Windows conversion at a time wit
h a bounded queue and deadline. Original reads remain limited to 8 MiB, 8,192 pixels per side and 20
million pixels. Thumbnail support depends on the PC's raster decoder; a failed thumbnail does not s
ilently download the original.
Tap an image to open its original in the page, or choose **Download original**. Image blobs stay in
bounded page memory; this view does not write them to browser persistent storage or the public asset
cache. Changing the conversation or connection, or disposing the page, cancels pending work and rel
eases its image URLs. Explicit downloads and DSH's own source files have separate storage lifetimes.
[该节后续省略]
## Privacy and transport
The supported phone content channels use authenticated encrypted requests and responses, including m
essages and protected workspace transfers. A passive tunnel relay receives ciphertext for those chan
nels. It still sees traffic metadata and serves the initial web application; a relay that actively s
ubstitutes that application is outside this protection. The model provider necessarily receives the
instructions submitted to it by DSH.
The raw original DSH web interface is not exposed as a remote alternative in new releases. Open the
original interface locally on the computer when needed. Encryption failures, missing keys, expired a
uthorization, and unsupported capabilities must be reported without falling back to plaintext remote
ion, and unsupported capabilities must be reported without falling back to plaintext remote content.
An optional primary and backup Quick Tunnel pair is available for the Windows gateway and is off by
default. Backup-address reminders can appear after every 1, 3 or 5 qualifying entries, a custom inte
rval from 1 to 9,999, or never. The default is every entry. A fresh navigation or reload counts only
after authentication and the encrypted connection are ready; conversation switches, reconnection an
d returning to an existing page do not count. Preferences and counts belong to the current browser o
rigin. Choosing **Never** suppresses every automatic popup, including a changed address, while the m
anual backup panel remains available. If browser storage fails, the panel explains that the interval
cannot be retained. The copied address carries no credentials; that other origin needs its own logi
n and encryption-key setup before it can be used. Both paths share the same PC, network and Cloudfla
re service, so they are not independent disaster recovery.
[该节后续省略]
